title: Dataset of intracranial EEG during cortical stimulations evoking negative motor responses
description: This dataset contains intracranial EEG (stereo-EEG) recordings acquired during 41 high-frequency electrical cortical stimulations that evoked negative motor responses. Data come from 23 patients undergoing presurgical evaluation for drug-resistant epilepsy. Each recording spans about 24 seconds around a stimulation and includes pre- and post-stimulation 5-second epochs, which were used for connectivity analysis. Stimulation contact pairs, current intensities and evoked effects are annotated in the events files.
methods_description: Bipolar high-frequency stimulation was delivered through stereo-EEG contacts using biphasic 1 ms pulses at 43.2 Hz (alternating polarity) or 50 Hz (non-alternating), with current intensity of 0.25-3 mA for up to 5 s. Each recording includes 9-10 s before stimulation, up to 5 s of stimulation, and 9-10 s after. Patients whose data met the inclusion criteria for network analysis (requiring the FreeSurfer pipeline) have anatomical data.
